title: I Built an AI trader, and still paper trading but showing great signs
author: Dear_Station_75
selftext: Started the paper account with $1,000 for testing. I'm seeing decent returns, and I am still making changes before releasing it. For those who are looking to get started, don't wait, this takes time and lots of energy before anything will happen.

comments.author: krazineurons
comments.body: If you're chasing edge then run the strategy through a backtest and compare against QQQ/SPY buy and hold. I have been building similar system for 3 months now. With AI Trading we tend to analyze every price movement and don't look at overall direction. So you'd see short term wins but might not actually come out as a winner.

replies.author: krazineurons
replies.body:
Yeah, but the regime aspects will kick in and reveal how much of an edge killer they are once the current market sentiment changes the tune. Whole point of back testing is to understand for what duration your strategy is actually profitable (if at all).

Anyway it's upto you. I have given up hopes on finding an edge, this is after having LLMs tune over 950 strategies. Have document the journey here

https://blue-grass-0beb37910.7.azurestaticapps.net/substack/index.html

comments.author: iDrinkBleach_8--D
comments.body:
Started my paper ai account with 100k. Using fable5 and he never maxes out the 100. 

He went down a couple grand the first few weeks until I adjusted when he enters. My AI would  buy in at any point over a certain target, had to teach him some patience. 

2 months and he’s up $5k. His trades are getting better and better..

Still playing with different strategies but going up $5k using 1 specific strategy gives me a lot of hope. 

I feel like I solved 75% of the issues with fixing when to execute the buys. Plus he journals everything so he’s learning and making suggestions to me now…

Fuckin love this shit!! It’s fun and can make some good money…

comments.author: Strong_Chard_4353
comments.body:
Love seeing this kind of progress, really cool stuff. The paper trading phase is so underrated honestly, most people skip it and go straight to live and wonder why they blow up.

  
I've been building something in a similar space called InsiderPulse (insiderpulse.org) - it's more of an AI signal discovery tool that scores market movements and flags interesting setups. Different approach to yours but same core idea of letting AI do the heavy lifting on analysis.

  
One thing I found super helpful during my build was tracking how the AI's predictions actually played out over time and feeding that back in. Basically letting the system learn from its own outcomes. Made a massive difference to signal quality.

  
Keep at it mate, the curve looks solid for a paper run.
